2607.29586.title: TraceViT: Grounded Trace Supervision for Visual Abstract Reasoning
2607.29586.paper_summary: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) tests whether a model can infer an unseen transformation from a few input-output examples and apply it to a new grid. Looped visual reasoners refine predictions over multiple iterations, but conventional training constrains only the final output, leaving intermediate refinements unconstrained. We propose that these refinements should instead follow the transformation step by step. We introduce TraceViT, a looped visual reasoner trained with semantically monotonic transformation chains. We obtain these chains by rewriting and verifying programmatic task implementations, decomposing each solution into intermediate grid states. Each iteration is grounded by a task reference derived from the few-shot demonstrations and an object workspace representing the current grid state. Because these chains may differ in length from the loop, soft trace alignment enforces only their ordering, letting the model allocate iterations freely. TraceViT achieves 67.8% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-1 and 24.3% on ARC-AGI-2. Controlled ablations on ARC-AGI-1 show that trace supervision becomes beneficial only when paired with grounding. Code and data will be available at https://github.com/LiuBinnan/TraceViT.
2607.29586.paper_summary_zh: 抽象與推理語料庫（ARC）測試模型是否能從少量的輸入-輸出範例推斷出未見的轉換並將其應用於新的網格。循環視覺推理器在多次迭代中精煉預測，但傳統訓練僅限制最終輸出，讓中間的精煉不受約束。我們提出這些精煉應該逐步遵循轉換。我們介紹了TraceViT，一種使用語義單調轉換鏈進行訓練的循環視覺推理器。我們通過重寫和驗證程式任務實現來獲得這些鏈，將每個解決方案分解為中間網格狀態。每次迭代都以來自少量示範的任務參考和表示當前網格狀態的物件工作區為基礎。由於這些鏈的長度可能與循環不同，軟追蹤對齊僅強制其順序，讓模型自由分配迭代。TraceViT在ARC-AGI-1上達到67.8%的pass@2，在ARC-AGI-2上達到24.3%。對ARC-AGI-1的控制性消融實驗顯示，追蹤監督只有在與基礎結合時才變得有益。代碼和數據將在https://github.com/LiuBinnan/TraceViT上提供。
